instructions: This set is written by people, about the documents the A4 proof run actually uploads (PROGRAM-2026-11-04 §4.A.1), before the run. Target n >= 30, at least one unanswerable question per document.

Write a question only for a document you have opened and read at the cited page. Copy the span verbatim from the page as a reader sees it, not from a text layer or OCR output; if the text layer reads differently, record that in textLayerReading.
A question enters the scored set only when humanVerified is true and verifiedBy names the person. The runner skips this whole set until PREREG.json pins its sha256.

The five rows below are worked examples of the schema. An agent wrote them from the pdftotext text layer of two NASA/NACA reports and did not view the page images; they are humanVerified=false and are not scored. Whether these two documents are in the A4 corpus is the A4 lane's decision, not this file's.

fieldSchema.corpusRef: string naming the corpus the question is asked of (a documents[].docRef, or a proof-run collection ref)
fieldSchema.question: string, 3..500 characters (the Ask route's limits)
fieldSchema.gold: null for unanswerable; else { acceptableAnswers: string[] (text) and/or numeric: { value, unit, decimals }, spans: string[] verbatim from the page }
fieldSchema.location: { docRef, pdfPage1, printedPage | null } -- unanswerable rows record what was searched instead (searched)
fieldSchema.textLayerReading: optional: what the document's text layer says where it differs from the page
